turns.reply:
It is completely unfair that your wages of Rs 42,000 for September and October 2026 have not been paid. Under Section 17 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s17]], employers must pay wages on time and cannot withhold them. 

### Where You Stand
* **Time limit for wages:** Under the Code on Wages, monthly wages must be paid before the expiry of the seventh day of the succeeding month [[COW2019:s17]]. By failing to pay for September and October, the factory has violated this rule.
* **Filing a claim:** You can file a formal claim before the designated labour authority under Section 45 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s45]], which also allows for compensation in addition to your unpaid wages.
* **Burden of proof:** The law explicitly states that the burden of proof to show that wages have been paid rests entirely on the employer [[COW2019:s59]].

I have prepared a draft wage claim application for you to submit to the labour authority in Tiruppur. 

### What You Need to Fill in the Draft:
* Your full name and address (`[YOUR NAME]`, `[YOUR ADDRESS]`)
* The exact name and address of the garment factory (`[FACTORY NAME]`, `[FACTORY ADDRESS]`)
* Your signature (`[YOUR SIGNATURE]`)

To help strengthen your case before filing, could you tell me:
1. Do you have any employment proof (such as an identity card, wage slips, appointment letter, or bank passbook showing previous payments)?
2. Have you or any coworkers spoken to the factory management or a labour union about this yet?

BEFORE THE AUTHORITY UNDER THE CODE ON WAGES, 2019
AT TIRUPPUR, TAMIL NADU

IN THE MATTER OF:
[YOUR NAME],
Residing at [YOUR ADDRESS],
Applicant

VERSUS

[FACTORY NAME],
Garment Factory, located at [FACTORY ADDRESS], Tiruppur,
Respondent

APPLICATION FOR RECOVERY OF UNPAID WAGES

1. The Applicant was employed with the Respondent garment factory at Tiruppur.

2. The Respondent has failed and neglected to pay the wages of the Applicant for the wage periods of September 2026 and October 2026, amounting to a total sum of Rs 42,000, in violation of Section 17 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s17]].

3. As per Section 17 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s17]], wages for monthly basis employees must be paid before the expiry of the seventh day of the succeeding month. The Respondent has defaulted on this statutory obligation.

4. Under Section 45 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s45]], this Authority is empowered to hear and determine claims arising out of non-payment of wages. Furthermore, under Section 59 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s59]], the burden to prove that wages have been paid rests entirely upon the employer [[COW2019:s59]].

PRAYER:
In light of the above facts, the Applicant respectfully prays that this Authority may be pleased to:

a) Direct the Respondent to pay the unpaid wages amounting to Rs 42,000 for the months of September and October 2026.

b) Award appropriate compensation as provided under Section 45 of the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s45]].

c) Pass any such further orders as deemed fit in the interest of justice.

Date: 2026-11-09

Place: Tiruppur

[YOUR SIGNATURE]
[YOUR NAME]
Applicant
